1. THE AREAS NOTED AS “EVERGREEN MILLS WIDENING POTENTIAL CONTRACTOR STAGING AREAS” THAT ARE LOCATED WITHIN THE HS-14 LIMITS OF DISTURBANCE (LOD)
ARE TO BE MADE AVAILABLE BY THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR FOR USE BY THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR . SHOULD THE EVERGREEN MILLS WIDENING
CONTRACTOR CHOOSE TO USE EITHER (OR BOTH) OF THE STAGING AREA LOCATIONS THAT ARE WITHIN THE HS-14 LOD, THEIR INTENTION MUST BE COMMUNICATED TO
THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR IN WRITING. AN AGREEMENT OR LICENSE THAT DETAILS REASONABLE CONDITIONS FOR ACCESS MAY BE DEVELOPED BY THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR
FOR EXECUTION BY THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR. ITEMS THAT MUST BE COORDINATED ARE NOT LIMITED TO BUT INCLUDE:
1.1. SITE CLEARING SCHEDULES
1.2. CONTRACTOR COORDINATION - THE EVERGREEN MILLS CONTRACTOR SHALL PROACTIVELY COORDINATE ALL WORK WITH THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR INCLUDING, BUT
NOT LIMITED TO, EARTHWORK, ACCESS, AND UTILITY COORDINATION. THE CONTRACTORS SHALL COORDINATE THEIR RESPECTIVE SCOPES, SCHEDULES AND
SEQUENCING TO AVOID CONFLICTS AND MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS PROGRESS OF WORK. ANY DISPUTES THAT ARISE REGARDING RESPONSIBILITY, ACCESS, EARTHWORK,
UTILITIES, SEQUENCING, OR OTHER COORDINATION MATTERS SHALL NOT BE USED AS JUSTIFICATION FOR DELAYS, DISRUPTION, OR FAILURE TO PERFORM WORK.
1.3. EROSION & SEDIMENT CONTROLS - EROSION & SEDIMENT CONTROLS MUST BE INSTALLED ACCORDING TO THE APPROVED PLANS (EPLAN-2023-0137). E&S
CONTROLS SHALL BE INSTALLED IN THE FOLLOWING ORDER OF PLAN PRECEDENCE: STEEPLECHASE LOOP DRIVE CPAP, HS-14 SITE PLAN, EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD
CPAP. CONTRACTORS' PRICING SHALL ASSUME THE INSTALLATION OF 100% OF THE E&S CONTROLS THAT ARE SHOWN ON THE APPROVED PLANS. IN AREAS WHERE
THE LOD FROM THESE PLANS OVERLAP AND THE E&S CONTROLS THAT WERE DESIGNED TO SUPPORT EACH PLAN INDIVIDUALLY ARE IN CONFLICT, THE CONTRACTOR
FOR THE WORK WITH LOWER PLAN PRECEDENCE SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR COORDINATING MODIFICATIONS TO THE E&S DESIGN WITH THE LOUDOUN COUNTY E&S
INSPECTOR. E&S MODIFICATIONS, TO THE EXTENT THEY ADD OR SUBTRACT FROM THE COST TO CONSTRUCT THE PROJECT, ARE TO BE PRESENTED TO THE OWNER
AS A POTENTIAL CHANGE ORDER (PCO) FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL PRIOR TO INSTALLATION.
1.4. STEEPLECHASE LOOP DRIVE CONSTRUCTION SCHEDULE - THE EVERGREEN MILLS CONTRACTOR SHALL NOT TO IMPEDE, DISTURB, OR DAMAGE ANY STEEPLECHASE
LOOP DRIVE AND ASSOCIATED INFRASTRUCTURE CONSTRUCTION. THE HS-14 AND EVERGREEN MILLS CONTRACTOR ARE TO CLEARLY COMMUNICATE THEIR INITIAL
SCHEDULES AND ALL SUBSEQUENT SCHEDULE UPDATES SUCH THAT STEEPLECHASE DRIVE IS AT LEAST BASE PAVED BETWEEN EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD AND THE
STAGING AREA(S) PRIOR TO THE STAGING AREA(S) BEING USED BY THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR. ANY DISTURBANCE, IMPEDIMENT, OR DAMAGE FROM
THE EVERGREEN MILLS CONTRACTOR TO STEEPLECHASE LOOP DRIVE AND ASSOCIATED INFRASTRUCTURE CONSTRUCTION SHALL BE RESOLVED BETWEEN
CONTRACTORS AT NO COST TO THE OWNER.
1.5. STORM CULVERT INSTALLATION - DUE TO PLAN AND VSMP PERMITTING REQUIREMENTS, THE STORM SEWER CULVERT/ PIPES/ STRUCTURES THAT ARE SHOWN AS
RUNS 704->703 AND 702->701->700 ON SHEET 15 OF THE STEEPLECHASE LOOP CPAP ARE ALSO SHOWN ON THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CPAP ON SHEET 6 AS RUNS
6-6->6-5 and 6-8->6-11->6-10. THE HS-14 CONSTRACTOR SHALL CONSTRUCT PIPE RUNS 6-6->6-5. THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR SHALL INCLUDE IN THE
BASE BID CONSTRUCTION OF PIPE RUNS 6-8->6-11->6-10. THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR SHALL INCLUDE CONSTRUCTION OF THE ROADWAY AND SIDEWALK
FOR STEEPLECHASE LOOP DRIVE FROM STATION 78+00 TO EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONNECTION. THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR SHALL BRING THE SITE TO SUBGRADE
AND/OR GRADE AND STABILIZE THE AREA. THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR SHALL PROTECT THE EXISITNG OVERHEAD UTILITY POLE ADJACENT TO THE CURB SO THAT THE
GRADING DOES NOT IMPACT THE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY OF THE UTILITY POLE.
1.6. VIRGINIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION LAND USE PERMIT(S) AND STREET ACCEPTANCE - THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE
FOR OBTAINING AND MAINTAINING THE APPROPRIATE PERMITS WITH THE VIRGINIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION (VDOT). IN THE EVENT THAT THE EVERGREEN
MILLS ROAD CONTRACTOR ELECTS TO USE ONE OR BOTH OF THE STAGING AREAS THAT ARE WITHIN THE HS-14, THE HS-14 CONTRACTOR SHALL NOT SEEK RELEASE
OF THEIR PERMITS AND/OR STREET ACCEPTANCE OF THE PORTION OF STEEPLECHASE LOOP DRIVE THAT IS BEING USED BY THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD
CONTRACTOR FOR ACCESS TO THE STAGING AREAS UNTIL AFTER THE FINAL COMPLETION DATE FOR THE EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD AS STATED IN THE CONSTRUCTION
CONTRACT.
1.7. EXISTING SOIL STOCKPILE AREA - THE EXISTING SOILS STOCKPILE AREA EAST OF HIDDEN FOX COURT HAS BEEN MADE AVAILABLE FOR USE BY THE HS-14 AND
EVERGREEN MILLS ROAD CONTRACTORS. THE CONTRACTORS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR COORDINATING EXCAVATION OF THE STOCKPILE FOR USE ON THEIR RESPECTIVE
PROJECTS WITH EACH OTHER AND THE E&S INSPECTOR. THE STOCKPILE EXCAVATED MUST BE TESTED AND APPROVED BY THE GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEER PRIOR TO
USE.
1.8. ACCESS COORDINATION - THE CONTRACTOR SHALL MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS AND SAFE ACCESS TO THE MIDDLE SCHOOL AND ALL ADJACENT PROPERTIES
THROUGHOUT CONSTRUCTION. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE ADEQUATE NOTICE PRIOR TO ANY CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES THAT WILL IMPACT AN ADJACENT
PROPERTY. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL CONDUCT ALL CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES IN A MANNER THAT IS RESPECTFUL TO ADJACENT PROPERTY OWNERS.
2. PROPERTY OWNER ACCESS - THE CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE ADEQUATE NOTICE TO PROPERTY OWNERS WHEN ACCESS TO THEIR HOMES AND LOTS CHANGES.
3. FLEETWOOD PROPERTY - THE CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE ENHANCED CONSTRUCTION FENCING WHEN EXISTING FENCING IS IMPACTED BY CONSTRUCTION.
4. OFFSITE LAYDOWN AREAS - THE CONTRACTOR IS NOT PERMITTED TO USE INDIVIDUAL PROPERTIES AS LAYDOWN AREAS.
